name: Praying To The Dead
overview: Scripture clearly forbids seeking guidance from the dead or familiar spirits, emphasizing that God alone is to be sought for wisdom and help. Passages such as Leviticus 19:31 and Deuteronomy 18:10-11 warn against consulting wizards, necromancers, or those who claim to communicate with the dead. Ecclesiastes 9:5 teaches that the dead have no knowledge or reward, underscoring that they cannot aid the living. Isaiah 8:19 challenges believers to seek the living God rather than turning to the dead, affirming the biblical rejection of praying to or seeking help from the departed.
